title: Tiflaan e Muslim
body:
WAQIA RANJ-O-MASAAIB KA BAYAN KARTA HUN
KOOFIOO NAY JO KYE ZULM AYAAN KARTA HUN
JIS GHARI KOOFAY MAIN MUSLIM(a.s.) NAY SHAHADAT PAY
UN KAY DO BAITON KI QISMAT MAIN YATEEMI AY
<<DIVIDER>>
BAAP KAY MARNAY SAY DUSHMAN KI JO HAIBAT CHAAY
DAR KAY JHAARI MAIN CHUPAY AKAY WOH DONO BHAI
HAAY IS UMR MAIN MAASOOMO PAY KAISAY BAIDAAD
DIL MAIN GHUM AANKHO MAIN AANSO THEY LABOO PER FARYAD
<<DIVIDER>>
KEHTAY HAIN JHAARI KAY NAZDEEK THI EK NEHAR RAWAAN
LONDI HAARIS KI JO PANI KAY LIYE AAY WAHAN
SUN KAY RONAY KI SADA HOGAYE DIL MAIN HAIRAAN
BARH KAY DEKHA TU NAZAR AGAY BACHAY DO NEHAAN
<<DIVIDER>>
BOLI KYUN ROTAY HO GHUM KIA HAI PISAR KIS KAY HO
CHUP KAY KYUN BETHAY HO TUM NOR-E-NAZAR KIS KAY HO
DEKH KAR MEHARBAAN AURAT KO WOH BOLAY RO KAR
HAAY KIS TARHAN KAHAIN KIS KAY HAIN HUM NOOR-E-NAZAR
<<DIVIDER>>
YEH MOHAMMAD(s.a.w.w.) KAY NAWASAY HAIN TUM MUSLIM(a.s.) K PISAR
LUT GAY HUM KAY YAHAN MAARA GAYA APNA PADAR
KOOFI DUSHMAN HUAY QISMAT MAIN SIYAAHI AAY
HAAY PARDAIS MAIN KAISI TABAHI AAY
<<DIVIDER>>
LONDI GHAR LAY KAY UNHAY AGAYEE BAA DEDAY NUM
APNI BIBI SAY KAHI BACHO KI RUDAADE ILAM
DEKH KAY BACHO KO BIBI KO HUWA BEHAD GHUM
BOLI AFSOOS KAY MASOOM PAY YEH ZULM-O-SITAM
<<DIVIDER>>
KITNE BAY DARD SITAMGAR HAIN YEH KOFAY WALAY
UN PAY KARTAY HAIN SITAM JO HAIN NABI(s.a.w.w.) KAY PAALAY
KHANA KHIWAA KAY UNHAY BIBI NAY POSHIDA KYA
RAAT KO HAARIS-E-BAD ZAAT JO GHAR KO AYA
<<DIVIDER>>
BOLA BIVI SAY BOHOT THAK GAYA TU KHANAY KO LAA
SUBHA SAY BACHO KO MUSLIM(a.s.) KAY MAIN HAR SO DHOONDA
HATH AJAY AGAR BACHAY TO INAAM MILAY
ZARO JAAGIR MILAY RUTBA MILAY NAAM MILAY
<<DIVIDER>>
KHAA KAY YEH KHANAY KO PHIR BETH GAYA WOH KHUD SIR
BACHAY THEY NEND MAIN KHOY HUAY HUJRAY MAIN UDHAR
HAAY QISMAT KAY UNHAY KHUWAAB MAIN YEH AAYA NAZAR
SAAMNAY KHOON MAIN DOOBA HAI KHARA UN KA PADAR
<<DIVIDER>>
CHEEKH UTHAY KHUWAB MAIN YEH DEKH KAY DONO BHAI
KAAN MAIN HAARIS-E-MALAOON KAY AAWAZ AY
HOGAYEE HAARIS-E-BAD ZAAT KO JAB USKI KHABAR
KHENCH KAY BACHO KO HUJRAY SAY WOH LAAYA BAAHAR
<<DIVIDER>>
JABKAY MALOOM HUWA DONO HAIN MUSLIM(a.s.) KAY PISAR
TEGH UTHAI KAY KARAY TAN SAY JUDA BACHO KAY SIR
HAATH KO THAAM KAY BIBI NAY KAHA OOH ZAALIM
YEH AULAD-E-NABI(s.a.w.w.) BAAP HAI IN KA MUSLIM(a.s.)
<<DIVIDER>>
JHATKA MAARA TO HUI ZAKHMI GIRI BAY CHAARI
LONDI NAY ROUKA TO TALWAAR USAY BHI MAARI
BACHAY KARTAY HI RAHAY MINNATAIN AAHO ZAARI
REHAM AAYA NA USAY JOSH THA US PER TAARI
<<DIVIDER>>
BOLA MAIN QATAL KARUNGA TUMHAY PAONGA INAAAM
AEHL-E-KOOFA MAIN BARHAY GAA MERA RUTBA MERA NAAM
CHOTA BOLA YEHI MARZI HAI TO PEHLE MUJHE MAAR OR BARA KEHTA ZAALIM MERA SIR PEHLE UTAAR
HAAY BAY DARD NAY JO KHENCH KAY MAARI TALWAAR
<<DIVIDER>>
LAASHAIN JAB TARPEEN TO THARRAY ZAMEEN BHI EK BAAR
AASMAAN RO DYA BACHO NAY SHAHADAT PAAY
HAAY ZEHRA(s.a.) KAY GULISTAAN PAY TABAHI AAY
SUN KAY YEH GHUM KI KHABAR KHULD SAY AAEN ZEHRA(s.a.)
<<DIVIDER>>
MAAILAY SEENA ZANI HONTO PAY THI AAH-O-BUKA
POHNCHI JAB NEHAR KAY NAZDEEK TO GHUM OR BARHA
NEHAR MAIN BACHO KAY LAASHO KO JO BEHTAY DEKHA
ROKAY KEHTI THI SITAM KAISA YEH AFLAAK HUWA
<<DIVIDER>>
HAAY IS GHUM SAY MOHAMMAD(a.s.) KA JIGAR CHAAK HUWA
